pr_title: Fix osu!mania long notes not displaying correctly since recent update
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/22572.

Should make "percy" long notes display maybe closer to expectation? Will need some testing. the `10000` constant can probably be adjusted to give perfect results. Maybe.

review_comments: I added this because I thought it was required but it turns out it wasn't. Will leave it in place because I'm sure we'll have to use it in the future to support some other skins.

Super confused at this - besides the fact that the old code was mixing `WidthForNoteHeightScale` and `MinimumColumnWidth`, as far as I can tell these are two separate config keys, and so should both be getting set if anything? As things stand the setter of `MinimumColumnWidth` is unused.
I'm super confused too. I've changed `MinimumColumnWidth` to match the stable implementation now.

Why did this height spec go away?

Seems like it may have been something to do with the `WidthForNoteHeightScale` addition? Relevant stable source is

```csharp
            float widthForHeightScale = Column.Host.Skin.WidthForNoteHeightScale > 0 ? Column.Host.Skin.WidthForNoteHeightScale : Column.Host.MinimumColumnWidth;
            float heightFactor = widthForHeightScale / d.DrawWidth * 1.6f * (d.FlipVertical ? -1f : 1f);
```

which uses both this and `MinimumColumnWidth`.

The stable version actually applies to not only long notes, but *all* mania notes. I do think that this should return, but first we need test scenarios (aka a user complaining things look wrong) before it's worthwhile.

In my original implementation I thought I was doing correct by implementing this, but it was a bit of a red herring.
